title: Tech Note: Hierarchical Lists in 4D v11 SQL
author: Thomas Fitch, Technical Support Engineer, 4D Inc.
featured_technology: Multiple form object references for one list (object name parameter)
SET/GET LIST ITEM family of commands
New v11 commands: SET LIST ITEM FONT/ICON/PARAMETER, Find in list

historical_commentary.text: This note documents a significant enhancement to 4D's Hierarchical List form control in 4D v11 SQL, allowing one underlying list (language object) to be displayed via multiple independent form objects with per-object selection, expand/collapse, and scroll state, plus several new commands (SET LIST ITEM FONT/ICON/PARAMETER, Find in list). Hierarchical Lists remain part of the 4D language and form object set today, so the underlying commands and multi-form-object concept are still broadly relevant, though the specific list of 'new for v11' commands is now simply the long-standing baseline and 4D has continued to add capabilities to hierarchical lists since this note was written.
related_updates: Hierarchical List form objects and their SET/GET LIST ITEM command family remain part of current 4D, though the command set has continued to evolve since 4D v11
Some legacy command names mentioned here (e.g. old DELETE LIST ITEM / INSERT LIST ITEM) were renamed to DELETE FROM LIST / INSERT IN LIST as part of this v11 update
